mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_loss_gain WHERE loss_gain_no = #{lossGainNo} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM inventory_loss_gain WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM inventory_loss_gain WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_loss_gain SET status = 'COMPLETED', audited_at = #{auditedAt}, auditor = #{auditor}, audit_opinion = #{auditOpinion}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{auditor} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'PENDING' AND version = #{version}

UPDATE inventory_loss_gain SET status = 'REJECTED', audited_at = #{auditedAt}, auditor = #{auditor}, audit_opinion = #{auditOpinion}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{auditor} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'PENDING' AND version = #{version}

UPDATE inventory_loss_gain SET adjust_type = #{adjustType}, warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, reason = #{reason}, remark = #{remark}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.loss_gain_no, g.warehouse_id, g.adjust_type, g.status, g.reason, g.remark, g.audited_at, g.auditor, g.audit_opinion, g.version, g.created_at, g.updated_at, w.warehouse_code, w.name AS warehouse_name FROM inventory_loss_gain g LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = g.warehouse_id WHERE g.deleted = FALSE AND g.id = #{id}
